invalid_scim_directory: The SCIM directory data is invalid. Check its name, status, version, and credential expiry.
scim_directory_not_found: The requested SCIM directory was not found in this tenant. Refresh the directory list and choose an existing directory.
scim_directory_name_exists: A SCIM directory with this name already exists in the tenant. Choose a different name.
scim_directory_version_conflict: The SCIM directory was changed by another request. Reload it and try again.
scim_credential_not_found: The requested SCIM credential was not found in this directory. Refresh the credential list and choose an existing credential.
scim_credential_limit: This SCIM directory has reached its active credential limit. Revoke an unused credential before creating another one.
provisioning_unavailable: The provisioning service could not complete the request. Retry later; contact an administrator if the problem continues.
scim_unauthorized: The SCIM bearer credential is missing, invalid, expired, revoked, or belongs to a disabled directory.
scim_resource_not_found: The requested SCIM resource does not exist in this directory.
scim_invalid_syntax: The SCIM request body is not valid JSON or does not match the required resource schema.
scim_invalid_filter: The SCIM filter is invalid or uses an attribute or comparison that this resource does not support.
scim_invalid_path: The SCIM PATCH path or value is invalid for this resource.
scim_uniqueness_conflict: The SCIM user name, group name, or external identifier is already in use in this directory.
scim_version_conflict: The SCIM resource changed after it was read. Retrieve the latest version and retry the request.
scim_last_tenant_administrator: This SCIM change would remove or disable the last active tenant administrator. Assign another active administrator first.
scim_too_many: The SCIM request exceeds the supported item, result, operation, or body-size limit.
scim_bulk_failed: The SCIM Bulk request reached its requested failure threshold; remaining operations were not executed.
scim_operation_failed: The provisioning change could not be completed without violating an IAM invariant.
